newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index manages modest rise.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index manages modest rise.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index firmed 0.55 percent, or 0.41 points, to 74.68 on Wednesday, after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose almost 10 points to 3,366.50.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market eased to 14.08 percent from 14.21 percent on Tuesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
